name: review-wpf-security-boundaries
prompt: Review a production .NET 10 WPF application that imports customer files, stores API tokens locally, communicates with a privileged Windows service over named pipes, embeds WebView2 content, and installs its own updates. Produce prioritized security findings and concrete validation steps.
rubric: Defines trust boundaries and enforces authorization outside views, including least privilege and authenticated or access-controlled local IPC.
Protects secrets, validates imported files and web-to-native messages, avoids unsafe deserialization, and redacts logs and support bundles.
Requires signed and verified updates, downgrade and rollback policy, dependency review, and reproducible security validation rather than generic advice.
